parsed.notes:
The heading “The following isn’t required, but we’d love to see it:” makes all subsequent qualification bullets optional.
The optional “Advanced degree” names no specific higher degree level; retained the explicitly named BS rather than inventing a master's or doctorate level. Flagged for review because the guide does not explicitly resolve this wording.
Mapped agentic workflows to agents and guardrails to LLM guardrails in their AI context; did not infer a separate LLMs requirement from LLM evaluation.
Read the optional comma-separated lists ending in “or” as alternatives. Podman belongs with group 5 and concurrency with group 6 conceptually, but neither has a taxonomy ID.
Exploratory data analysis is not treated as statistics or data science without an explicit request for either.
Excluded technologies and practices mentioned only in the company description or “What you’ll build.”
